findings: In `meaning_history.senses[1].text`, the assertion that the inscription’s stellar referent is disputed is too strong: the scan reports “可能指的是火星,” while the cited CUHK entries interpret 火星 here as the historical name for 大火/心宿二, not necessarily the planet Mars. Clarify that 字源 gives the broader historical name 火星 and does not itself specify 心宿二; the inspected references identify the star as 心宿二. Apply the same correction to `relationships[1].text` and `meaning_history.limitations[0].text`, removing the claim that the sources disagree on the celestial object while retaining that the naming motivation is unresolved. Cite X-c9906898947db9e1ac73, X-7b0c28c0b19ce3360222, X-545b2dbbc2615091e8b6, and X-b6e5639abbf3b5853106.
